newsitem.title: UK: BARCLAYS SEEN UP 3 PCT ON RESULTS, BUY-BACK.
newsitem.headline: BARCLAYS SEEN UP 3 PCT ON RESULTS, BUY-BACK.

text.p: Shares in Barclays Plc were expected to open about 40p higher after reporting strong profits for the first half of the year and that it would have greater than expected scope for share buy-backs this year, traders said.
The shares ended Wednesday at 13.27-1/2 stg.
"They were a splendid set of results and the buy-back news was pleasing." a trader said.
The British bank said pre-tax profits rose eight percent to 1.376 billion pounds and it raised its dividend by 17 percent to 13.5 pence per share.
The profits figure of 1.376 billion pounds is before one-off charges of 105 million sterling following the UK government's recent budget.
Analysts had forecast pre-tax profits in a range between 1.216 billion and 1.347 billion sterling.
Barclays shares hit a record 13.33 stg Wednesday.
